title: Connect to WiFi & sign in with SSO
description: Connect the workstation to the corporate Wi-Fi network "Acc3ssGr@nted" and sign in with your SSO credentials to begin provisioning.
helpText:
1. In the Windows taskbar, open Wi-Fi settings.

2. Connect to the network named: Acc3ssGr@nted

3. Sign in using your GE HealthCare SSO credentials.

4. Confirm you can browse to an internal resource.

When signed in, click Mark Completed.

title: Request E5 license access
description: Open the access request portal to request the Microsoft E5 license upgrade required for GlobalProtect VPN and engineering development.
helpText:
1. Click Request Upgrade.

2. Select your GE HealthCare email account.

3. Choose: New GEHC PC or MAC

4. Reason: Requesting the Microsoft E5 license upgrade to enable GlobalProtect VPN access and support engineering development on my workstation.

5. Submit the request and wait for approval before continuing VPN-dependent steps.

title: Connect GlobalProtect VPN
description: Establish the GlobalProtect VPN connection to the corporate network so secured engineering resources are reachable.
helpText:
1. Open GlobalProtect.

2. Sign in with your SSO credentials.

3. Wait for the connection to establish.

4. Verify you can open an internal GE HealthCare resource.

Click Mark Completed once connected.

title: Complete SSO & device enrollment
description: Finish single sign-on and Microsoft InTune device enrollment so the workstation is fully managed.
helpText:
1. Open the Company Portal / InTune app.

2. Sign in and complete device enrollment.

3. Confirm the device shows as compliant.

Click Mark Completed once enrollment is finished.

title: Complete GenAI Copilot training
description: Finish the GenAI Copilot course on Emerge U, the required learning for Copilot access.
helpText:
1. Open Emerge U in your browser.

2. Locate and complete the GenAI Copilot training course.

3. Save your completion certificate / record.

Click Mark Completed once the course is finished.

title: Email manager about GenAI access
description: Notify your manager by email once the GenAI Copilot training is complete, as required before access is granted.
helpText:
1. Open your email.

2. Send your manager an email confirming you have completed the GenAI Copilot training.

3. Request that GenAI Copilot access be approved.

Click Mark Completed after sending.

title: Submit Saviynt access requests
description: Request the GitLab, Copilot, and standard LinkedIn/Copilot access in Saviynt under the E5 request.
helpText:
1. Open Saviynt Access Requests.

2. Request the following:
   - APP_Gitlab
   - SCIM_gehc_ghemu-copilot
   - SCIM_gehc_ghemuall

3. Submit the requests and track approval status.

Click Mark Completed once submitted.

title: Configure GitLab access token
description: Generate and securely save a GitLab personal access token required to clone and interact with the WomensHealthUltrasound repositories.
helpText:
1. Open GitLab at gitlab.apps.ge-healthcare.net.

2. Generate a personal access token with read_repository / write_repository scope.

3. Save the token securely in your password manager.

You will use it when cloning the repository.

Click Mark Completed once the token is ready.

title: Install Windows updates & drivers
description: Run Windows Update and Dell Support Assist to install the latest OS updates and drivers.
helpText:
1. Open Windows Update settings.

2. Check for updates and install all pending updates.

3. Open Dell Support Assist and update drivers/firmware.

4. Restart if required.

Click Mark Completed once the system is up to date.

title: Partition the drive
description: Create a dedicated data partition (for example D:) for engineering source and build artifacts.
helpText:
1. Open Disk Management (diskmgmt.msc).

2. Shrink the main volume by the desired size.

3. Create a new simple volume and assign it a drive letter (for example D:).

4. Format the volume.

Click Mark Completed once the partition exists.

title: Install Google Chrome
description: Install Google Chrome, the standard browser used for onboarding links and bookmarks.
helpText:
Run the installer. It skips installation if Chrome is already present.

When the script finishes with a success message, click Mark Completed.

title: Install Git & Git Bash
description: Install Git and the Git Bash shell for version control workflows.
helpText:
Run the installer. Git is required for cloning the SystemSource repository and for daily source control.

When the script finishes with a success message, click Mark Completed.

title: Install Git Extensions
description: Install the GitExtensions graphical Git client used for repository management.
helpText:
Run the installer to add Git Extensions for visual repository interaction.

When the script finishes, click Mark Completed.

title: Install .NET SDK
description: Install the required .NET SDK for building the solution.
helpText:
Run the installer to provision the .NET SDK.

When the script finishes, click Mark Completed.

title: Install Windows SDK
description: Install the Windows SDK required for Win32 and driver development.
helpText:
Run the installer to add the Windows SDK.

When the script finishes, click Mark Completed.

title: Install Visual Studio 2026 (vs-Config)
description: Install Visual Studio 2026 using the team VS configuration workload file (vs-Config).
helpText:
Run the installer with the team's VS 2026 config. Workloads are defined in Configs\vs2026.vsconfig.

Visual Studio is the primary IDE for opening and building Voluson.sln.

When the script finishes, click Mark Completed.

title: Add standard browser bookmarks
description: Add the standard onboarding bookmarks to Chrome for quick access to internal resources.
helpText:
Run the script to add the standard bookmarks.

When the script finishes, click Mark Completed.

title: Create C:\dev\master workspace
description: Create the C:\dev\master folder that hosts the cloned repository.
helpText:
1. Create the folder: C:\dev\master

2. Open Git Bash in this folder.

Click Mark Completed once the folder exists.

title: Clone the SystemSource repository
description: Clone the WomensHealthUltrasound SystemSource repository into C:\dev\master using your GitLab access token.
helpText:
1. Open Git Bash in C:\dev\master.

2. Clone using your token:

   git clone https://gitlab.apps.ge-healthcare.net/WomensHealthUltrasound/SystemSource.git

3. Authenticate with your GitLab username and the access token you generated.

4. Verify the folder contains the solution.

Click Mark Completed once the clone succeeds.

title: Install required fonts
description: Install the fonts used by the product UI and documentation on this workstation.
helpText:
1. Locate the font files (typically in the repo or a shared drive).

2. Select the .ttf/.otf files and choose Install.

3. Verify the fonts appear in the Fonts control panel.

Click Mark Completed once fonts are installed.

title: Open & build Voluson.sln
description: Open the Voluson solution in Visual Studio 2026 and build it successfully.
helpText:
1. Open Visual Studio 2026.

2. Open the solution: C:\dev\master\...\Voluson.sln

3. Select the appropriate configuration (Debug/Release).

4. Build the solution (Build > Rebuild Solution).

5. Resolve any missing workloads or SDKs as prompted.

Click Mark Completed once the build succeeds.

title: Run getBinaries
description: Run the getBinaries step to retrieve any required third-party binaries for the build.
helpText:
1. Follow the getBinaries instructions in the repository documentation.

2. Run the getBinaries step to fetch third-party binaries.

3. Verify the binaries are downloaded to the expected location.

Click Mark Completed once getBinaries succeeds.

title: Validate the environment
description: Run the Validation section to confirm all required commands, files, and configurations are in place.
helpText:
1. Open the Validation section.

2. Click Run Validation.

3. Review the results and resolve any ERROR items.

Click Mark Completed once validation is clean.
